programs.title: Food Paradise
programs.desc: The best steaks, sandwiches, burgers and briskets that America has to offer  from meatloaf and pot roast nachos in Chicago to a 3-pound pork chop in Denver, it's a carnivore's carnival as we go looking for the biggest and best meat dishes in the US.

programs.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programs.sub_title: You Made Your Bread, Now Eat It
programs.desc: Acclaimed chef Michael Voltaggio and TV host Jaymee Sire pair up to topple Bobby Flay  they bring in Yehuda Sichel and Remy Pettus, two young and hungry chefs hot on the path to take down the culinary king.

programs.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programs.desc: Food Network's Giada De Laurentiis brings in pal Meredith Vieira to try to beat Bobby Flay in 25 ingredients or fewer  chefs Marcos Campos and Nicholas Poulmetis try not to slip up on the star ingredient for a shot at taking down the king.

programs.title: Midnight Misadventures With Mallika Dua
programs.desc: With Shalexa in need of repair, Shalishka makes fondue with comics Kaneez and Sumukhi and puts their friendship to the test.

programs.title: Food Paradise
programs.desc: Hot lobster rolls and blue crab spaghetti get dressed in robes of butter at restaurants in Boston and New York  bakeries in San Francisco, Washington, DC and Atlanta bring butter to new heights in their flaky pastries.

programs.title: Chopped: Food Truck Kitchen
programs.desc: Food truck chefs battle it out  Chinese and Greek cuisine ingredients in the first basket  a classic American street food meets a fun-to-say Korean dish in the entrée basket  unripe fruit and a much-loved sweet spread in the final basket.

programs.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programs.desc: Food Network's Sunny Anderson and Christian Petroni try to snow in Bobby Flay for the season  Minnesota-native chefs Karyn Tomlinson and Erick Harcey do their best to bring the frigid winter into Bobby's kitchen.
